name: Loving Hut Vegan Express (City Heights/Talmadge)
notes: 3 photos, all printed menu pages. Photos 1 and 2 are two price versions of the same Western Specialties / Noodle & Noodle Soups pages (photo 2 is an older, lower-priced version with a Gardein Burger instead of an Impossible Burger and missing a few items); merged as duplicates and used photo 1's newer set. Photo 3 covers the separate Ocean & Rice Dishes section.
